auxiliaryData.label: Anschlüsse
auxiliaryData.value: HDMI In/Out, USB-B/A/C, LAN, WLAN, BT

ports.label: USB-C In
ports.notes: One connector carries DisplayPort 1.1 video (HDCP 1.4), a USB 3.0 host, a 1000BASE-T Ethernet link and up to 60 W charging.

ports.label: USB Host
ports.notes: USB 3.0 Type-B — second wired host for the built-in triple USB switcher

ports.label: HDBT Out
ports.notes: Mirrors HDMI Out. HDMI 1.4, HDCP 1.4; 2160p50/60 drop to 4:2:0. Pairs with an HDBT receiver such as PT-HDBT-1020HU-RX.

ports.label: Utility LAN
ports.notes: BYOD side: AirPlay/Chromecast signal input and network access for attached devices

ports.label: Secure LAN
ports.notes: Control side: LAN control, Web UI and Telnet API

ports.label: USB 3.0 1
ports.notes: USB peripheral expansion (keyboard, mouse, touch screen, camera, speakerphone); 1 A per port

ports.label: USB 3.0 2
ports.notes: USB peripheral expansion (keyboard, mouse, touch screen, camera, speakerphone); 1 A per port

ports.label: USB 3.0 3
ports.notes: USB peripheral expansion (keyboard, mouse, touch screen, camera, speakerphone); 1 A per port

ports.label: Audio Out
ports.notes: Balanced analog output on a single 5-pin 3.5 mm phoenix connector

ports.label: RS-232
ports.notes: 3-pin 3.5 mm phoenix — controls a peripheral (e.g. a display) or accepts control of this device

ports.label: Pairing
ports.notes: USB-C service port for pairing and upgrading the VL-DGL200 sharing dongle
